surface_verification.justification: pure CLI-tooling follow-up fixes (write_context_term.py, context_md_format.py, _write_context_term_cli.py, and their tests); no startable web/dev-server surface of its own to browser-verify -- verification is the unit test suite itself (F0).

behaviors.behavior: legacy CLI-flag test functions are named for the legacy-flag path they actually cover, and no stale cross-reference to the old name remains
--term/--definition/--avoid's own --help text warns against shell-composed interview text and points at --payload-file
interview-protocol.md's fenced bash blocks never contain a --term-shaped invocation (only --payload-file is sanctioned)
a payload-file caller's blank avoid is rejected with a message naming the payload's own field spelling (avoid/clear_avoid), not only the CLI flag spelling
a wrapped _Avoid_ continuation line that starts with a bolded cross-reference to another term is absorbed into the avoid text, not mistaken for that other term's own entry
an unrelated hand-written note separated from _Avoid_ by a blank line is preserved as its own raw block, not swallowed into the avoid text
the three pre-existing hidden-duplicate rejection cases still fail upsert_term as before (the item-5 parser fix does not weaken duplicate detection)
